mapper.select: SELECT * FROM merchant_referral_bounty WHERE merchant_member_id = #{merchantMemberId} AND del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO merchant_referral_bounty (merchant_member_id, inviter_member_id, merchant_registered_at, window_expires_at, status, del_flag, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{merchantMemberId}, #{inviterMemberId}, #{merchantRegisteredAt}, #{windowExpiresAt}, #{status}, '0', NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE merchant_referral_bounty SET status = 1, activated_at = #{activatedAt}, verified_heads_snapshot = #{snapshot}, bounty_amount = #{amount}, paid_at = #{paidAt}, frozen_until = #{frozenUntil}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0
UPDATE merchant_referral_bounty SET status = 3, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0
